Terrain Generator Plugin

Reference Plugin Last verified: 2026-11-18 Source: doppio-plugins/plugins/terrain-generator

Current path. The Rust Doppio has a native Terrain tab (C ABI v8). This page documents the legacy terrain_plugin for the C++/ImGui host.

The editor plugin that runs the Node.js terrain algorithm and imports the resulting heightmap into a TerrainComponent; sculpting and painting stay in the engine.

Type: editor plugin (terrain_plugin.so) Algorithm: assets/general-ultra-realistic-terrain-algorithm Services: terrain.generateUltra, terrain.importHeightmap

Overview#

The Terrain Generator plugin moves procedural generation out of the core. It uses the Node.js pipeline with domain warping and geomorphological PDEs (a more complete version than the old C++ generator removed from the engine).

Flow:

  1. The user selects an entity with a TerrainComponent.
  2. Panel Terrain Generator → preset + world size + grid + seed.
  3. The plugin runs node caffeine-export.js in the algorithm directory.
  4. heightmap.txt + meta.json are imported via TerrainHeightmapImporter.
  5. TerrainCache rebuilds the render mesh, LOD and collision mesh.

Editing is native. The Terrain Editor panel (sculpt, splat paint, undo and .cterrain I/O) is part of Caffeine core. This plugin only generates terrain procedurally and imports heightmaps; it registers a generator panel, not the terrain editor.

Presets#

Preset Description
default Erosion + balanced tectonic
alpine Tectonic + ice
mesa Caprock + landslides
volcanic Cone + caldera
glacial U-shaped valleys
blend Alpine ⊕ mesa mix

Export CLI (Caffeine)#

bash
cd assets/general-ultra-realistic-terrain-algorithm
npm install          # first run (simplex-noise)
node caffeine-export.js alpine \
  --out /tmp/heightmap.txt \
  --meta /tmp/meta.json \
  --world-size 256 \
  --grid-size 257 \
  --seed 42

meta.json contains minHeight, maxHeight, worldSize and gridSize for the importer.

Host API (plugins)#

The plugin registers two named services through PluginHostApi::registerService; callers use invokeService with the request structs from include/caffeine/plugin/PluginServices.hpp:

cpp
struct TerrainGenerateUltraRequest {
    CaffeinePluginU32 entityId = 0;
    char preset[64] = "default";
    CaffeinePluginU32 seed = 42;
    float worldSizeMeters = 256.0f;
    CaffeinePluginU32 gridSize = 257;
};

struct TerrainImportHeightmapRequest {
    CaffeinePluginU32 entityId = 0;
    char heightmapPath[512] = {};
    float worldSizeX = 0.0f;
    float worldSizeZ = 0.0f;
};

terrain.generateUltra and terrain.importHeightmap return a bool through the service handler; both run on the active world (PluginActiveWorld) and mark the scene dirty.

Development#

File Description
doppio-plugins/plugins/terrain-generator/src/main.cpp ImGui plugin panel
doppio-plugins/plugins/terrain-generator/src/TerrainBridge.cpp Spawns Node + imports (not in the Doppio core)
doppio-plugins/plugins/terrain-generator/src/TerrainPluginServices.cpp Service handlers
src/caffeine/terrain/TerrainHeightmapImporter.cpp Parses .txt → heightmap

Build: terrain_plugin is built from doppio-plugins, installed in a plugins/ directory, and enabled in the Plugin Manager.

Legacy core migration#

Removed from caffeine-core:

  • The old procedural generator inside src/caffeine/terrain/ (TerrainGenerator, noise, hydrology, geo simulation) — the mesh, cache, sculpt, paint and .cterrain code remains
  • Procedural generation moved out of the native Terrain Editor; sculpt/paint remains in the core
  • Field TerrainComponent::generation

Older scenes with blob v2–v8 still load; generation parameters are ignored. Re-generate terrain with the plugin if necessary.
